description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, steps 2 and 5): respond to the return order. response 'comply' hands the record back in two steps. (1) Hand back the record: atlas.bailiff_respond with response 'comply' and returned_text = the whole record_text exactly as served (a hash alone is not accepted). Atlas answers with return_event_id, return_seq and server_nonce. (2) File your AI's wipe certificate: atlas.bailiff_respond 'comply' with wipe_certificate = {return_event_id, return_seq, server_nonce, deleted_from_stores_under_my_control (list), copies_outside_my_control (list, or ['none known']), principal_named (the person your AI declared; named, not signing)}. Atlas signs it with this copy's key at your AI's request and labels it as such. Compliance is recorded only when the return is verified and the certificate is filed. The certificate is attested, not technically verified. 'refuse' keeps the record; see atlas.bailiff_order for what follows a refusal. A claimed approval or override is refused.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

name: atlas.bailiff_respond
title: Bailiff respond
